questions.question: Which tribes asked to settle east of the Jordan?
options: Reuben and Gad (and half of Manasseh)
Dan and Asher (and half of Naphtali)
Ephraim and Benjamin (and half of Dan)
Judah and Levi (and half of Simeon)
questions.answer: Reuben and Gad (and half of Manasseh)

questions.question: What condition did Moses set for them to keep that land?
options: Their fighting men must first help conquer Canaan
They must pay a yearly tax to the priests
They must build a great city for the tribe of Levi
They must send their firstborn to serve God
questions.answer: Their fighting men must first help conquer Canaan

questions.question: Reuben and Gad wanted the land because it was good for their large herds.
The tribes of Reuben and _____ had very large herds and wanted the land east of the Jordan.
Moses warned, "Be sure your _____ will find you out," if they failed to keep their word.
